cohort_selection.unique_baseline_clocks: First-WATCH timestamps of all WATCH symbols in the same frozen date

features_and_source.archive: daily 1m per necessary UTC date, always matching official publisher SHA256 .CHECKSUM
features_and_source.each_bar: open/high/low/close/quoteVolume/trades; timestamp microsecond normalized to ms
features_and_source.momentum: percentage close change vs 3/15/60 complete minutes earlier
features_and_source.liquidity: quote volume 1/3/15/60min, ratio recent15min vs prior45min normalized, trade counts 1/15/60, 60min nonzero-minute share
features_and_source.excluded: BTC indicators, future GT, future HIGH, future volume, trade executions, future price from feature row
features_and_source.label: FROM_EXISTING_FROZEN_STAGE34_GT_2X_CALENDAR_BASELINE; retrospective ONLY; compare EARLY_STRICT/NOT_2X/NO_WATCH only

output.per_date: all WATCH first watch +20 no-WATCH reference-clock controls, each with source SHA and feature identity
output.aggregate: stage/cohort/date coverage + blinded descriptive medians/quartiles and missing rates + multiple comparisons caveat
output.checks: no future, source hashes verified, counts per date and all 1227 WATCH, 360 control, 18 dates, immutable input checksum

limitations: All calendar windows and winner labels already exposed; cannot perform independent model selection validation
Historical 758 snapshot is not point-in-time listing universe
Control clock is sampled from other symbols' WATCH moments, not a random independent market day
Historical Spot OHLCV cannot prove 30USDT executable bid/ask or true fills
No Futures/DEX source included in this stage
